name: docs-deployment-kubernetes-md-00

outcome.error: deserializing from YAML containing more than one document is not supported

yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: rift
  labels:
    app: rift
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: rift
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: rift
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: rift
          image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
          ports:
            - name: admin
              containerPort: 2525
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 9090
          env:
            - name: MB_PORT
              value: "2525"
            - name: MB_ALLOW_INJECTION
              value: "true"
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "128Mi"
              cpu: "250m"
            limits:
              memory: "512Mi"
              cpu: "1000m"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: admin
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: admin
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: rift
spec:
  selector:
    app: rift
  ports:
    - name: admin
      port: 2525
      targetPort: admin
    - name: metrics
      port: 9090
      targetPort: metrics
